description: Log a buy or sell trade for capital gains tracking. Sell trades return realized gain/loss with cost basis, holding period, and federal/state estimates. Feeds the 1099-DA export. Requires API key.

asset_class.description: stock/security/equity enables wash-sale tracking; digital_asset/crypto do not

asset_symbol.description: Asset ticker: equity (AAPL), crypto (BTC), or token (COMPUTE-TOKEN)

estimated_annual_income.description: Enables bracket-aware federal estimate and NIIT detection

resident_state.description: Resident state for the state capital gains estimate

specific_lot_id.description: Lot ID, required when accounting_method is specific_id

trade_date.description: ISO 8601 trade timestamp; defaults to now

name: log_trade
title: Log a trade for capital gains
